HARWICK & DOYLE CONSULTING — CORPORATE CARD DESK
Query from cardholder Leonie Marsh (card ending 4471): "Which of my September purchases got declined? I got a decline text but deleted it."

Card programme rules (Corporate Card Terms, schedule B)
B1 Cycle limit: USD 6,000.00 per statement cycle. The September cycle runs 1–30 September 2026.
B2 A purchase is approved only if the amount it would charge, including any fee charged with it, is not more than the available limit at that moment. A declined purchase has no effect on the limit.
B3 Available limit = cycle limit − settled purchases and fees in the cycle − open authorisations + restored amounts.
B4 Pre-authorisations (hotels, car rental): the authorised amount is held as an open authorisation. When the merchant settles, the settled amount replaces the authorised amount. An authorisation that has not settled is released at 00:00 on the 8th calendar day after the day of authorisation.
B5 Foreign transaction fee: 3 % of the USD amount of any purchase from a merchant outside the United States, charged together with the purchase.
B6 Refunds: a refund of the full amount of a purchase restores that amount to the available limit on its posting date. A partial refund is credited to the statement balance but does not restore available limit within the cycle.
B7 Fees and refunds on pre-authorisations follow the settlement, not the authorisation.
